evidence: Changes wallet spend routines, coin selection, fee-bumping, and wallet database schemas to enable sending to BIP 352 addresses.
rationale: Adds BIP 352 silent payment sending support to the wallet, delivering a strategically important privacy feature for transaction creation. As the description notes, it introduces dynamic derivation of taproot scriptPubKeys from spending input private keys, updates coin selection, and persists recipient destinations to enable RBF fee-bumping across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall.
